warnAgentsMdTooLarge: AGENTS.md is {size} KB but Codex only reads the first {limit} KB — the rest is ignored. Move long rules to Codex skills (codex_mode: skill) or raise project_doc_max_bytes in ~/.codex/config.toml.
warnClaudeReadsAgentsMd: This project has no CLAUDE.md, so Claude Code also reads AGENTS.md (Codex's file) and sees those rules twice. Add a CLAUDE.md, or switch the AGENTS.md fallback off in Claude Code's /config.
warnClaudeMdImportsAgentsMd: {path} imports {'@'}AGENTS.md, so Claude also reads Codex's rules and sees them twice.
warnCodexReadsClaudeMd: {config} lists CLAUDE.md in project_doc_fallback_filenames, so Codex may read Claude's instructions.
warnLinksNotIgnored: {dir} holds Devdy symlinks that git does not ignore. Committed, they point to a path on this machine and break for everyone else — add it to .gitignore or .git/info/exclude.
warnLegacyCopiesBackedUp: Old skill/rule copies that may hold local edits were moved to {dir} ({count} batch(es)) when switching to symlinks. Check them, keep what you need, then delete that folder to clear this notice.
warnTrackedByGit: The repo commits its own files at {paths}. Devdy leaves them alone and does not install there, so the repo's version is what Claude/Codex load.

worktrees.title: Worktrees
worktrees.hint: "Start with AI in its own worktree" sessions work in .devdy/worktrees/<name> on branch devdy/<name>, created from the latest remote code. Rules/skills and .env files are carried over.
worktrees.setupCmdHint: Runs in a new worktree before the session starts (install dependencies…). Leave empty if not needed.
worktrees.removeMessage: Delete the worktree and branch {branch}? Uncommitted or unpushed changes in it are lost.
